items.title: GE Vernova (GEV) Sees New Risks From AI Data Center Permitting Pause
items.summary: GE Vernova (NYSE: GEV) faces fresh political headwinds after a Democratic sweep in recent U.S. elections on 4 November 2026. Newly elected Democratic officials in Texas have publicly pledged to pause approvals for large-scale data center infrastructure tied to AI workloads. Early regulatory proposals in several states focus on tighter energy, zoning, and environmental reviews for power-hungry data center projects. items.title: Bloom Energy Sinks 16% Despite 900 MW NTT DATA Deal as Midterm Fears Hit AI Power Stocks
